## What this changes

## Tests (red, then green)

- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test that failed before the change
- [ ] All tests pass locally (`pnpm test`, and `pytest` for services/maths)

## Docs

- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased, `docs/WORKSTREAMS.md` status)

## Accessibility

- [ ] Any new or changed screen, dialog or look passes the contrast sweep in every look, light and dark (decision 0012)

## Privacy

- [ ] No real names, schools, emails or other personal data in code, tests, fixtures or docs
